title: Smart MONSTER Door
tagline: Build a secret passcode door lock with keypad, servo latch, and access alarms!

phases.instructions: Collect the 4x4 matrix keypad, SG90 micro-servo motor, servo horn, piezo buzzer, and breadboard.
verificationCheckpoints: SG90 servo with single-arm horn attached

phases.instructions: Wire Keypad rows to pins 9-6, cols to pins 5-2. Connect Servo PWM signal to Pin 11 and Buzzer to Pin 12.
verificationCheckpoints: Servo Red wire to 5V, Brown to GND

phases.instructions: Make sure the servo arm has room to swing freely from 0 to 90 degrees without bumping into components.
verificationCheckpoints: No power short on servo leads

phases.instructions: Inspect the keypad scanning routine and servo unlock deadbolt logic.
phases.codeExplanation:
- SECRET_CODE stores the 4-digit master passkey.
- lockServo.write(0) extends the deadbolt into the locked position.
- Upon passcode match, lockServo.write(90) pulls back the bolt to open.

phases.instructions: Upload sketch and tap digits '1234' on the keypad. The servo deadbolt should swing open for 3 seconds!
Vault secured! You built a real physical access control system with matrix scanning and servo mechanics.
verificationCheckpoints: Ready to claim Smart Security badge

variants.title: Reverse Deadbolt Mechanism
variants.description: Invert servo throw angles (0 deg locked, 90 deg unlocked) and add auto-lock timer.
variants.codeAdaptation: Change servo.write(90) to servo.write(0) and track millis() for 10-second auto relock

extensionMissions.title: Lockout Tamper Penalty
extensionMissions.objective: Add a security lockout that disables keypad inputs for 60 seconds after 3 consecutive wrong passcodes.
hints: When failedAttempts >= 3, record millis() and ignore key presses until 60,000ms elapse

story: Protect your monster vault! Construct a motorized safe door featuring a 16-key matrix keypad, 9g micro-servo locking deadbolt, and wrong-passcode siren.

troubleshooting.solution: Unplug the 8-pin keypad ribbon and reverse its pin connection.
diagnosticSteps: Verify ribbon cable row/column order against pin table.
Ensure keypad library #include <Keypad.h> is installed in Arduino IDE.
